extracted.name: Patty Pan Squash
extracted.description: Seasoned with lemon, garlic, and fresh herbs, this sautéed patty pan squash recipe is a delicious summer side dish. Serve it with pasta, pizza, or any protein you like.
ingredient_lines: 8 ounces patty pan squash (cut into 1-inch pieces)
¼ teaspoon sea salt (plus more for sprinkling)
instruction_lines: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the squash, salt, and several grinds of pepper and sauté for 7 to 10 minutes, stirring occasionally, or until the squash is tender but still has a firm bite.
Turn off the heat and stir in the lemon juice, garlic, and parsley. Transfer to a serving dish and top with fresh basil and red pepper flakes, if desired.
